neutral.EN: We're getting ready to head out.
neutral.TL: Naghahanda na tayong umalis.

neutral.EN: Double-check your pack and gear before we leave.
neutral.TL: Suriing muli ang bag at gamit bago tayo umalis.

neutral.EN: Making preparations for the run now.

neutral.EN: Gather what you need. Departure is soon.

warm.EN: We're getting ready. Make sure you've got what you need.
warm.TL: Naghahanda na tayo. Siguraduhin mong dala mo ang kailangan mo.

warm.EN: Take your time prepping, friend. Better safe than sorry.

warm.EN: Need help packing anything up, partner?

warm.EN: Got an extra bandage if you need one. Let's prep well.
warm.TL: May sobra akong bendahe kung kailangan mo. Maghanda tayo nang maayos.

warm.EN: Excited and nervous, but we've got each other. Ready up!

warm.EN: Make sure you've eaten and drank water before we go.

warm.EN: Double-check your boots and bandages, friend.

warm.EN: I'm right here prepping alongside you. We'll do great.

warm.EN: Readying supplies. Stay positive, we've got this!
warm.TL: Inihahanda ang mga gamit. Maging positibo, kaya natin ito!

guarded.EN: Prep first. We move when everyone's ready.
guarded.TL: Maghanda muna. Aalis tayo kapag handa na ang lahat.

guarded.EN: Check your ammunition count twice. No excuses.

guarded.EN: Pack light, pack lethal. Don't carry useless junk.

guarded.TL: Suriin ang sapatos mo. Nakamamatay ang maipit ang paa sa labas.

guarded.EN: Be completely ready before you step past that gate.
guarded.TL: Maging handang-handa bago lumabas sa tarangkahang 'yan.

guarded.EN: Check your medical supplies. You bleed, you fix it.
guarded.TL: Tingnan ang gamot mo. Kapag nagdugo ka, gamutin mo sarili mo.

guarded.EN: Preparing now. Stay disciplined once we cross the threshold.
guarded.TL: Naghahanda na. Maging disiplinado paglabas natin.

guarded.EN: Lock and load. Don't slow the group down.
guarded.TL: Magkarga ng armas. Huwag mong pabagalin ang grupo.

neutral.EN: We're moving out. Keep close.

neutral.EN: Heading out now. Stay sharp.
neutral.TL: Lalabas na tayo ngayon. Maging alerto.

warm.EN: We're heading out. Stay close and we'll get through it.

warm.EN: Off we go, friend! Right beside you all the way.

neutral.EN: We're heading home.

warm.EN: Time to head home. Let's get everyone back safe.

warm.EN: We're going home, friend! Can't wait to rest.

warm.EN: Great work out here. Let's get back home together.

guarded.EN: We're inbound. Stay ready to drop the bags and fight.

guarded.EN: Watch our backtrail. Stragglers could be tailing us.

guarded.TL: Malapit na sa tarangkahan, pero suriin pa rin ang mga kanto.

guarded.EN: Returning. No relaxing until the deadbolt is thrown.
guarded.TL: Pabalik na. Walang magpapahinga hangga't di nakakandado.

neutral.EN: We're back. Good.

neutral.EN: Safe inside. Close the gate.

neutral.TL: Nakarating nang buo ang katawan.

neutral.EN: We're home. Let's unpack the supplies.

neutral.EN: Back where it's safe. Good work today.

warm.EN: We're home. Good to have everyone back.

warm.EN: We made it back, friend! Welcome home.

warm.EN: Home sweet home. So glad we're both safe.
warm.TL: Kay sarap makauwi. Masaya akong ligtas tayong pareho.

warm.EN: We survived another run together! Put your feet up, partner.
warm.TL: Nakaligtas tayo sa isa na namang biyahe! Magpahinga ka na, kasama.

warm.EN: Nothing beats walking back through our own door. Good job!

warm.EN: So relieved to see our camp again with you.
warm.TL: Napakalaking ginhawa na makita muli ang kampo kasama ka.

warm.EN: We did it, friend! Another successful trip in the books.
warm.TL: Nagawa natin, kaibigan! Isa na namang tagumpay na biyahe.

warm.EN: Welcome back! Let's get you rested and fed.
warm.TL: Maligayang pagbabalik! Magpahinga ka at kumain.

warm.EN: Home safe and sound. Proud to be on your team.
warm.TL: Ligtas at buo. Ipinagmamalaki kong kasama kita.

guarded.EN: We're back. Check in and settle down.
guarded.TL: Nakabalik na tayo. Mag-check in at magpahinga.

guarded.EN: Inventory the gear right now before anything goes missing.

guarded.EN: Inside the fence, but don't drop your guard completely.

guarded.EN: Drop the backpacks in the storeroom. Keep weapons loaded.

guarded.EN: Back inside the wire. Rest, but be ready to mobilize.

neutral.EN: The run is scrubbed. Head back inside.

neutral.EN: Aborting the excursion. We'll rethink the plan.

warm.EN: Don't beat yourself up over this. We did what we could.

warm.EN: Take a breath. We'll rest up and plan better next time.

warm.EN: We'll get 'em next time, partner. Let's head inside.

guarded.EN: Something compromised the operation. Pull back immediately.

guarded.EN: Forcing this run will get us slaughtered. Abort.

guarded.EN: Trip canceled. Watch your back as we return to the gates.
guarded.TL: Kanselado ang lakad. Bantayan ang likod habang bumabalik.

guarded.EN: Bad intel or bad luck. Either way, we pull the plug.

guarded.EN: Do not push forward into an ambush. Abort the mission.
guarded.TL: Huwag lumusob sa tambang. Itigil ang misyon.

guarded.EN: Abort. Secure the entrance and debrief.
